title: Colimit of the explicit compatible-root quotient
statement: For any natural p and commutative ring R, the actual compatible-root quotient tameRootAlgebra p t is the colimit in rings of the finite simultaneous-root quotients over the positive orders coprime to p, ordered by divisibility and mapped by power substitution. Its canonical inclusions send each finite root to the root carrying its order label. The universal property holds for arbitrary ring maps into any commutative ring, including across universes. With an empty parameter tuple its coefficient map is bijective. A separate wrapper of the order set, with divisibility as its preorder, is nonempty and directed, as is its universe lift.

source.place: 04AX, polynomial quotient universal property; ILO IX 2.1 compatible root presentations.

proof.text: The two sets of defining relations give the root-power equation and the compatibility equation in the full quotient. Use the finite quotient lift to define each inclusion and check its compatibility on roots.

Given compatible maps from all finite levels, take the coefficient map from level one. Compatibility with the arrow from level one to each level makes all coefficient maps equal. Evaluate each labelled variable at the image of its finite-level root. The finite power equations kill the power relations; compatibility of the family kills every transition relation. Descend the evaluation to the full quotient. It extends each finite map by coefficient and root extensionality. Any two extensions agree on coefficients, as checked at level one, and on every labelled root, as checked at its own level; hence they agree on the entire quotient.

For the empty tuple the finite-level maps back to R are the no-variable equivalences. The colimit lift is a left inverse to the coefficient map, checked at level one, and a right inverse, checked on coefficients since there are no variables. For the index wrapper, order one witnesses nonemptiness and the product of two orders is a common upper bound; positivity and coprimality are closed under products. Lift the same common upper bounds to ULift.
